metadata.title: A blue Texas threatens Musk’s expanding footprint and hopes for SpaceX-Tesla deal

content.text:
Investing.com -- Texas flipping blue is a headwind for Musk's empire and a speed bump for a merger, not a deal-killer. The pre-market moves show it. SpaceX (SPCX) is indicated at $131.99 (-6.60%) as of Nov 4, 9:01 AM EST, against a $141.31 close on Nov 3. Tesla (TSLA) is at $378.38 (-5.05%) against a $398.50 close.
SpaceX (SPCX): $141.31 close || Pre-market $131.99 || 52W range $104.83–$225.64 || 1M: -11.10%
Tesla (TSLA): $398.50 close || Pre-market $378.38 || 52W range $297.38–$498.83 || YTD: -12.95%
Prices are as of the stamps above. Pre-market prints are thin and can reverse.
What Changed
-
Texas: Democrats won the governorship (Gina Hinojosa over Greg Abbott), a US Senate seat and several statewide offices. Reuters via Investing.com, Nov 4, 2026
-
Congress: Democrats also took both chambers. Musk backed Republicans with nearly $450M. Reuters via Investing.com, Nov 4, 2026
-
Oversight: Robert Garcia, the incoming House Oversight chair, told Republicans and their allies to "Lawyer up." Democrats had reportedly considered probing Musk's companies.
Operating Risks
Data centers are the pressure point. Hinojosa campaigned on a moratorium on new data centers and an end to tax breaks. SpaceX plans to grow compute from 1.7 GW to as much as 13 GW next year. Texas and Georgia hold roughly a third of US AI data-center investment. Investing.com, Nov 4, 2026
Boca Chica is exposed. Hinojosa opposed a possible beachfront state-park sale to SpaceX: "Texas is not for sale."
Government exposure is large. SpaceX earns billions from government contracts, and Starlink matters for defense. Oversight is likely to increase.
Offsetting bull case: Morgan Stanley's Adam Jonas nearly doubled his 2027 estimates. He now sees $175B in 2027 revenue and $289B in 2028, with free cash flow turning positive in 2031 rather than 2035. Investing.com, Nov 4, 2026 Musk also joked that "data centers in space" look appealing.
Merger Odds
Where it stands: Both companies formed special committees. Musk said a combination has "a lot of merit," with "no guarantee" of a deal. Reuters put its size at about $3.5T. Talks are early. Reuters via Investing.com, Oct 20, 2026
Headwinds, now larger:
-
Reuters reported that Musk's public endorsement could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay talks by weeks, with echoes of the SolarCity litigation. Reuters via Investing.com, Oct 23, 2026
-
A Democratic Congress can hold hearings and put pressure on regulators. Antitrust risk was already flagged.
-
Bloomberg reported an effort to announce a deal in H1 2027, so it could close while Trump is in office. That timeline now looks tighter.
